versions.changelog:
launchthatbot-import 1.2.3

- Updated version number from 1.2.2 to 1.2.3 in SKILL.md and package.json.
- No functional or documentation changes introduced in this version.

- Improved documentation for end-to-end encrypted export of OpenClaw agent data, memory, skills, and secrets to LaunchThatBot deployments.
- Detailed step-by-step instructions for both Quick API and Air-gapped file import modes.
- Clarified the security model: all secrets are RSA-encrypted client-side and never exposed to LaunchThatBot servers.
- Added user confirmation and prerequisites checklist before exporting sensitive data.
- Outlined precise instructions for collecting, encrypting, and uploading agent configuration and secrets.
